expertiseSources.summary: Documents the strict portable frontmatter contract and rejection of runtime-specific fields.
Defines verified native versus authorized source-loading routes in each worker context without permission expansion or global installation.

exception.rationale: The workflow preflights required skills against actual host discovery and authorized source routes without inventing tools, expanding permissions, or installing global configuration. Artifact selection also qualifies applyTo scoping by actual host support rather than presenting one host's convention as universal authorization. Project/personal ownership and portable-profile controls remain intact. Generic fixtures request review; model uplift and completed human approval are not claimed.
